g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the firm POST to trigger a signing request?')
sendPrompt('What does the API do when it receives initiate request?')
sendPrompt('How is the Base64 document decoded and stored?')
sendPrompt('How is the raw document stored in the DB?')
sendPrompt('How is the signing token generated and what does it contain?')
sendPrompt('What columns are in the SigningRequests table?')
sendPrompt('How are the OutboxQueue row and SigningRequest inserted atomically?')
sendPrompt('What payload does the SendEmail job carry?')
sendPrompt('How does the BackgroundService pick up and send the signing email?')
sendPrompt('What does the signing email look like to the claimant?')
sendPrompt('What happens when the claimant opens the signing link?')
sendPrompt('How does the API validate the token on page load?')
sendPrompt('What DB query checks the token is valid and not expired?')
sendPrompt('How does the API return the document for rendering in Blazor?')
sendPrompt('How does Blazor render the document for the claimant to read?')
sendPrompt('What data is POSTed when the claimant submits their signature?')
sendPrompt('How does the submit handler validate the token before processing?')
sendPrompt('What payload does the StampPdf queue job carry?')
sendPrompt('What rows are written when the submit transaction commits?')
sendPrompt('How does the StampPdfHandler embed the signature into the document?')
sendPrompt('How is the signed document stored back in the DB?')
sendPrompt('What emails are sent after successful signing?')

svg.text: Token expired / invalid → 410 Gone returned to browser
Job fails → retry ×3 → OutboxQueue_Failed → admin alert
